name: rlynjb-aipe
description: Spec workflow plugin for AI-assisted development

plugins.name: aipe
plugins.description: Generate filled specs from 15 disciplined templates across two flows — action (Describe → Diagnose → Act) and reflective (Evaluate, Teach + Rehearse) — plus two orchestrators (study, rehearse) that run their families in one pass. Uses your agent's own model, no external CLI.
